modules.module_title: Maintain safe and secure working environment

pcs.pc_description: identify hazardous activities and the possible causes of risks or accidents in the workplace
follow safe working practices while dealing with hazards to ensure safety of self and others
carry out routine check of the machine for identifying potential hazards
use appropriate protective clothing/equipment for specific tasks and work
follow safety hazards and preventive techniques during fire drill
report any identified breaches in health, safety and security policies and procedures to the designated person
ensure workstation and equipment are regularly clean and sanitized
clean hands with soap, alcohol-based sanitizer regularly
avoid contact with ill people and self-isolate in a similar situation
wear and dispose PPEs regularly and appropriately
report advanced hygiene and sanitation issues to appropriate authority
follow stress and anxiety management techniques

modules.module_title: Perform work as per quality standards

identify ways to optimize usage of material in various tasks/activities/processes
check for spills/leakages in various tasks/activities/processes
plug spills/leakages and escalate to appropriate authority if unable to rectify
check if the equipment/machine is functioning normally before commencing work and rectify wherever required
report malfunctioning (fumes/ sparks/emission/vibration/noise) and lapse in maintenance of equipment
ensure electrical equipment and appliances are properly connected and turned off when not in use

modules.module_title: Support paintshop technician or operator in preparatory activities

pcs.pc_description: identify the material, tools, equipment, jigs and accessories required for the job
collect the required tool kits and material from the stores and ensure that all the items required are available as per SOP
check the tools and incoming vehicle body or parts in White (BIW) for any defects and that they are as per the required quality standards
return the tools and vehicle body or parts to body shop/ stores if they are not as per the required quality standards
clean the vehicle body or parts properly and ensure that they are free from all dust particles
use masking tape to mask the vehicle body or parts areas as per the paintshop operator instructions
check that vehicle body or parts are locked properly in locking clamp of jigs and fixtures, if not then clamp it manually or tie it with a wire as per the WI/SOP
ensure that there is no damage done to the vehicle body or parts during loading/unloading on pulleys, chains and other hoisting mechanisms
record the data of the vehicle body or parts going for the pre-treatment process

modules.module_title: Support paintshop technician or operator in body treatment and painting activities

pcs.pc_description: hold the tools and accessories required during body treatment and painting activities in the correct manner as specified by the operator using appropriate PPE
provide appropriate consumables and accessories to technician or operator during body treatment and painting process
wipe extra sealer, under body PVC and extra SGC (Stone Guard Coating) from the painted vehicle body or parts
clean and store the tools, equipment and process auxiliaries as per organisational guidelines after completion of work
remove the masking tape and jigs from vehicle body or parts after completion of all painting activities
support in checking the painted parts as per the work instructions for product quality
support in segregating, tagging and storing the right quality parts into Ok pieces, defective pieces which can be repaired/reworked and pieces that are beyond repair
clean the workarea properly after completion of work
dispose scrap and waste material into the disposal area in accordance with the company's policies and environmental regulations
